findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-103.11: (O) FOOD EMPLOYEES are informed in verifiable manner of their responsibility to report accordance with LAW, to PIC, information about their health related to disease transmissible through FOOD.  

Employee reporting agreements or another similar verification is not available during this inspection. A copy of the reporting agreement given out by SCDPH was given to the facility. They made multiple copies and had staff sign during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x2) 6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris. 

The baseboards in the boys bathroom are pulling away from the wall. PIC is instructed to reseal the locations beck to the wall to ensure that they are smooth and easily clean able.

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

There are multiple ceiling tiles in all three observed bathrooms that need replacing. PIC instructed to replace as needed.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

1) The inside roof of the black microwave is observed with encrusted food debris. 2) The red microwave is observed generally soiled on all inner surfaces with food debris. PIC is instructed to ensure that food contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained clean between uses.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11  (C) Cutting boards on the counter in the kitchen are stored with soiled cloth pot holders on top of them. Food contact surfaces need to remain protected from contamination at all times until use.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14  (Pf) The test kit observed at the facility does not register the concentration of Chlorine (CL) in parts per million (ppm). PIC is instructed to ensure that the test strips used in the facility will be intended for food service. Inspector will follow up on November 5, 2019.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed milk to have no date mark. Potentially hazardous foods must always be date marked within 24 hours of opening.
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
(REPEATx2) Observed no bleach test kit for the facility. Provide a test kit.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed the hand sink the kitchen to be slow draining. Repair this issue.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1) (REPEAT) Observed the boys bathroom tiles to be peeling on the floor. Replace the tiles to make them smooth and easily cleanable.
2) (REPEAT) Observed an absence of coving in the boys restroom. Pictures were documented to be placed in the file.
3) Observed a piece of tile missing underneath the three compartment sink. Replace tile to make it a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
1) (REPEAT) Observed an absence of caulk at the far girls restroom. Re-caulk the sink to the wall.
2) Observed multiple spider webs on the wall in the corner of the kitchen where the air conditioner box is located. Clean the walls as needed.
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed cut fruit at 47 F and ranch dressing at 48 F.  Ranch was discarded and fruit was moved to a different cooler.  Service the unit and it should be holding temperature at 41 F.
750-250  All potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at 41°F or below while on display and service.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.comment:
Observed the cook's hair to be down during the inspection.  Inspector asked for her to put her hair up.  (IMMEDIATELY CORRECTED)  Hair should be off the shoulders.
750-530e Employees shall maintain a high degree of personal cleanliness and shall conform to good hygienic practices during all working periods in the food service establishment.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1) Observed a heavy accumulation of frost buildup in the freezer.  Defrost the unit. 2) (REPEATx2) Observed an absence of handle on soda cooler.  Repair so that a handle is present and it is smooth and easily cleanable.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Observed no bleach test kit for the facilty. Provide a test kit.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
Observed no bleach on site.  The cook went during the inspection to get bleach.  Properly provide a test kit for bleach. 50 ppm in three compartment sink and 100ppm for sanitizer concentration.
750-820d Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed mold growth in the soda cooler.  Sanitize the shelves.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.
